title: Universal Pizza Script
features: This script gives you pizza that you can eat
script:
local backpack = game.Players.LocalPlayer.Backpack

local Tool = Instance.new("Tool")
Tool.Parent = backpack
Tool.Name = "Pizza"
Tool.TextureId = "rbxassetid://22595979"

Tool.GripForward = Vector3.new(-.989, 0, .149)
Tool.GripPos = Vector3.new(.55, -.1, -.1)
Tool.GripRight = Vector3.new(-.149, 0, -.989)
Tool.GripUp = Vector3.new(0,1,0)


local handle = Instance.new("Part")
handle.Name = "Handle"
handle.Parent = Tool

local mesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
mesh.MeshId = "rbxassetid://22589477"
mesh.TextureId = "rbxassetid://22589467"
mesh.Parent = handle

local DrinkSound = Instance.new("Sound")
DrinkSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://22593942"
DrinkSound.Parent = handle

local OpenSound = Instance.new("Sound")
OpenSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://22593428"
OpenSound.Parent = handle

enabled = true

function onActivated()
	if not enabled then
		return
	end

	enabled = false
	Tool.GripForward = Vector3.new(.995, -.0995, -0)
	Tool.GripPos = Vector3.new(.3, -.8, 1.55)
	Tool.GripRight = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
	Tool.GripUp = Vector3.new(0.0995, .995, 0)

	DrinkSound:Play()

	wait(.8)

	local h = Tool.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
	if (h ~= nil) then
		if (h.MaxHealth > h.Health + 1.6) then
			h.Health = h.Health + 1.6
		else    
			h.Health = h.MaxHealth
		end
	end

	Tool.GripForward = Vector3.new(-.989, 0, .149)
	Tool.GripPos = Vector3.new(.55, -.1, -.1)
	Tool.GripRight = Vector3.new(-.149, 0, -.989)
	Tool.GripUp = Vector3.new(0,1,0)

	enabled = true
end

function onEquipped()
	OpenSound:Play()
end

Tool.Activated:Connect(onActivated)
Tool.Equipped:Connect(onEquipped)

game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification",{
	Title = "Executed!",
	Text = "Script made by floppa_scripter",
	Icon = "rbxassetid://22595979"
})
